story.iWant: every baseline parameter traced to a public source
story.soThat: a reader can check where the numbers came from
story.tasks: - Gather and verify (AC: 1–9) - Scenarios (AC: 9, 10) - Data README and ADR (AC: 11, 12) - Tests, lint, close out (AC: 13)

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: See story file ACs 1–13. The status vocabulary and the "ratios, not absolutes" preamble are normative. Figures pre-verified by the dev manager are listed in the story's References with access dates; the builder verifies the remaining ones.

docs.doc: Ratio reasoning, pool-depth decision, Chainlink, volatility, attacker ratio, status vocabulary.
Tolerance rule for the calibrated scenarios.
Boundary at ratio ≈ 1; baseline is placed on it deliberately.

existing.reason: Structure and header-comment style to copy.
No schema changes expected. If a calibration needs a field that does not exist, stop and add a Blockers section rather than extend the schema.

dependencies.python: No new runtime dependencies. For candle retrieval, a one-off script may use urllib (stdlib); do not add requests.
dependencies.network: The builder on Seoul has normal internet. Record every URL and access date. If a source is paywalled or requires a key, say so and mark the row secondary.

story-context.constraints: - No config schema changes. No kernel/protocol/agent code changes. - Every parameter row has all five columns and a status; CI-side test asserts SOURCES.md has no row with an empty status cell (simple regex over the markdown table). - Both calibrated scenarios must terminate by something other than max_steps; the fix order is for_steps/tolerance → attacker ratio → nothing else. - Committed data files ≤ 1 MB each; CSV only; retrieval documented. - Numbers in SOURCES.md are copied from the source verbatim, with the conversion shown; never pre-rounded. - The pool-depth limitation (constant-product underestimates near-peg liquidity, overestimates slippage far from peg) must appear in SOURCES.md verbatim or close to it; it goes into the note. - Python 3.12-compatible.

interfaces.interface: Preamble (ratios, not absolutes; status vocabulary) then one ## section per parameter group, each a markdown table with columns: parameter | value used | source (URL, accessed) | raw figure | conversion | status
One section per committed file: path, source URL, retrieval command or steps, date, sha256, row count, columns.
Header comment: one line per parameter group pointing at the SOURCES.md section; ADR-0017 ratio statement; ADR-0013 tolerance statement.

tests.standards: tests/test_calibrated_scenarios.py: both files load and validate; content_hash is stable; a short run (max_steps 500 override via model_copy) completes; SOURCES.md status-cell regex test; data files exist and are under 1 MB.
